text:
Alex C: Hey team — can I get a short admin window to pull a subset of inference logs for a privacy redaction sweep? Need to search traces for exposed PII in LLM chat traces for customer_id=cust-842. Will not persist extracted logs.
Maria O: @Alex C can you list exact resources + duration? also please open a ticket in SEC-ACCESS with justification.
Alex C: resources: `k8s://inference-prod/namespaces/chat-logs` and the S3 prefix `s3://redwood-inference-prod/logs/inference/chat/*/2026-03-17/*`
Alex C: duration 45m max, read-only, will run `rg` locally and only pull matched lines. 
Alex C: sample command: ```kubectl -n inference-prod exec -it log-viewer -- sh -c "rg \"cust-842\" /var/logs/chat* | sed -n '1,200p'"``` 
Maria O: OK please attach the ticket link. We need approval from SRE on-node portforward policy and from Data Protection for retention handling.
Jordan P: SRE: we can allow a port-forwarded `kubectl` session if it's recorded. @SRE Bot kick off the recording and add audit tag `tmp-elev-3123456789`.
SRE Bot: recording session started: session_id=rec-78634, start_ts=3123456890. Audit tag `tmp-elev-3123456789` applied.
Alex C: added ticket SEC-ACCESS-1122 with reason and redaction plan: "grep-only, will redact and delete extracts after verification" — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-ACCESS-1122
Maria O: Data Protection acked, please ensure you mask any user identifiers in the pulled snippets before sharing in Slack. Use hashed ids or `REDACTED_ID`.
Sam K: Quick note: if you find KV cache keys or raw prompts include PII, stop and escalate.
Alex C: understood — will stop on any raw prompt hits. Starting now.
SRE Bot: ephemeral role grant: `admin:logs-read-only` granted to Alex C for 45 minutes. expires_ts=3123459520
Alex C: got it, running now. Will post a redacted summary when done. :thumbsup:
Maria O: thanks — keep this thread for the audit trail and link the final redaction artifact to SEC-ACCESS-1122.
Alex C: done — pulled ~18 matches, redacted, uploaded to SEC bucket `s3://redwood-sec/scrubs/SEC-ACCESS-1122/redacted_v1.txt` — link: (internal) and added retention=7d. closing window.
SRE Bot: session rec-78634 ended at 3123457098. ephemeral role revoked.
Maria O: confirmed logs were uploaded and redaction looks good from a spot check. marking as approved in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
Alex C: thanks everyone, appreciate the fast turnaround!
